visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short hair and glasses, wearing a black button-down shirt, stands centered in front of a snowy outdoor background with trees and a white snowman. He gestures with his hands while speaking expressively. (2) A close-up shot transitions to show a pile of dried brown shiitake mushrooms with distinct white patterns on their caps, filling the entire frame. (3) The scene cuts back to the man in the snowy setting, who continues his enthusiastic speech with varied facial expressions and hand movements, often holding a small black device. (4) The visual switches to a macro view of white, thread-like fungal mycelium interwoven within dark brown organic substrate or soil. (5) Returning to the man, he remains in the same snowy environment, using broad hand gestures to emphasize his points. (6) A technical shot displays an electronic breadboard on a wooden surface with red, blue, and black wires connected to two dried mushrooms placed on metal plates. (7) The final sequence alternates between the man speaking in the snow and close-ups of the mushrooms or mycelium, ending with him making rhythmic gestures.

(5) [Subtitle]: 但問題可大了. (6) [Subtitle]: 摩爾定律撞牆. (7) [Subtitle]: 還遇到 AI 深度學習的耗電大魔王. (8) [Subtitle]: 更別提做晶土非得用的稀土礦. (9) [Subtitle]: 也難怪科學家一直想搞. (10) [Subtitle]: 「神經形態計算」(Neuromorphic Computing). (11) [Subtitle]: 就是模仿大腦啦. (12) [Subtitle]: 你想嘛 你的大腦功耗才 20 瓦. (13) [Subtitle]: 雖然有洞 但比一顆電燈泡還省電. (14) [Subtitle]: 能存算一體、平行運算. (15) [Subtitle]: 邊看泛科學新聞邊.. 放下那張衛生紙. (16) [Subtitle]: 那要怎麼「造」出這個大腦晶片. (17) [Subtitle]: 第一條路是用「半導體」去模仿. (18) [Subtitle]: 這結果還是要開採那些稀土礦. (19) [Subtitle]: 製程還是高耗能、高污染. (20) [Subtitle]: 用完還是一堆電子垃圾. (21) [Subtitle]: 那第二條路 不然來玩真的. (22) [Subtitle]: 科學家直接在培養皿裡養「神經類器官」. (40) [Subtitle]: 在陽光下曬了七天. (41) [Subtitle]: 這一步超重要. (42) [Subtitle]: 解決了「神經類器官」濕答答的致命缺陷. (43) [Subtitle]: 能長期保存帶著走. (44) [Subtitle]: 不管接下來是要測試還是要吃. (45) [Subtitle]: 再噴點水就好. (46) [Variety]: Nice. (47) [Subtitle]: 然後他們在加濕過的乾香菇上面 插滿電線. (48) [Subtitle]: 開始用不同的電壓去電它. (49) [Subtitle]: 從 0.1 Hz 一路飆到 10000 Hz. (50) [Subtitle]: 根本是想讓香菇復活. (51) [Subtitle]: 這時科學家發現 這塊香菇乾竟然學會了「記憶」.
